factorial_complex_comparison.coefficient_layout: Matrices have outgoing roots as rows, incident roots as columns, and [real, imaginary] entries.

scope: All four responses use the original reference planes and two quadratic thickness layers. The control meshes partition the physical tetrahedron replacements. Each effect subtracts the two matching corners with the other region held fixed. The mixed difference subtracts the central increment at coarse exterior from the central increment at refined exterior. The equal incoherent mean uses five equal-power inputs. Coefficient effects share the baseline port gauges and retain physical end-plane phases. The finer and coarser partitions each use their own nested donor pair. These are finite changes at one frequency. Spatial and frequency convergence remain unresolved.
